experience.title: Happy 2nd Birthday, Vaibhav!
experience.subtitle: Hamare chhote superstar ke liye dher saara pyaar, masti aur khushiyan!
experience.formHeading: Vaibhav ke liye ek pyari si wish bhejein
experience.formDescription: Bas apna naam likhiye, ek wish chuniye aur bhej dijiye. ❤️
experience.wishBoardHeading: Kittu ke liye sabki pyaari wishes 💛
experience.relationshipPlaceholder: Aap Vaibhav ke kya lagte hain?

experience.metaDescription: Vaibhav ka 2nd birthday! Kittu ko Hinglish mein pyaari si birthday wish bhejein.
experience.letterHeading: Hamare Kittu ke naam ek pyara sa note
experience.letterMessage: Hamare pyare Vaibhav, tumhari hasi se ghar mein raunak aa jaati hai. Hamesha haste-khelte raho, khoob khelo aur sabka pyaar paate raho. Dher saara pyaar, Kittu!
experience.cakeMessage: 2 saal ke ho gaye hamare chhote champion! Chalo candles bujhaate hain aur dher saari taaliyan bajaate hain!
experience.finalMessage: Bhagwan tumhe sehat, khushiyan aur dher saara pyaar de. Aise hi muskurate raho, Vaibhav!
